design_overview: A modern, patient-centric hospital appointment booking system with clean navigation, intuitive scheduling flows, and clear visual hierarchy. The design prioritizes ease of use for both patients booking appointments and doctors managing their schedules, with a professional healthcare aesthetic featuring calming blues and accessible touch targets.

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen widths 375px-428px. All touch targets minimum 44x44px. Cards and lists use full width with 16px horizontal padding. Bottom navigation fixed at 56px height. Scrollable content areas account for safe areas and navigation bars. Horizontal scrolling used for date selectors and specialty filters. Grid layouts for time slots adapt to screen width with 2-3 columns.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant with minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratios for text. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Form inputs include visible labels and placeholders. Status information conveyed through text and color. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Error messages clearly associated with form fields. Alternative text provided for all images and icons.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability: button press states with 0.15s scale animation, card taps with 0.2s elevation change, screen transitions with 0.3s slide animations, loading states with skeleton screens, success confirmations with checkmark animation, modal appearances with 0.25s fade and slide from bottom, tab switches with 0.2s underline slide, toggle switches with 0.2s state change. All animations respect reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style for inactive states and filled style for active states. Icons include: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person silhouette), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (favorite), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (delete), share (arrow). All icons 24px size with 2px stroke weight, rendered in current text color for consistency.
